current.summary: Full design resync, then real UI implementation. Took three passes: a first resync that was too thin, two rounds of user pushback that were both correct, and finally a four-way split of the design canvas in Claude Design that made the whole of it readable for the first time. 485 KB recovered against 262 KB truncated. Then built five screens and six components on the corrected tokens, with 97 tests passing.
current.state: Design source complete and single-vintage (4 mobile parts + admin, none truncated); every colour read from PAL rather than inferred; 5 of ~30 screens built; no backend; never run on a device
decisions: Discard rather than merge design snapshots - a half-stale archive is the trap that produced the bad first resync. Cost the old PAL; the split recovered it anyway

Split the canvas into four parts, done in Claude Design - the 256 KiB cap is server-side on get_file with no range or pagination, so the repo cannot initiate it. Sent split-plan.md into the project rather than making the user retype it
Match the design's token names exactly even where mine read better: screenBg2 is the page, screenBg stayed white. Future syncs diff directly
Supply is two states in the app (ok/thin), three in the back office (HEALTHY/THIN/CRITICAL) - different audiences. The copy is the real decision: 'New in Gaborone · 2 providers', never '2 nearby'
JourneyShape on CategoryToken so rentals structurally cannot offer a booking
DecisionPair ships as one component so 'never two blue buttons side by side' cannot be half-applied
New-provider boost is one slot, non-compounding, second position - earns a look, does not claim to be the best match
working: Four mobile design parts + admin canvas, all truncated:false. 485 KB vs 262 KB from the single-file pull
PAL recovered: both modes read, not derived. Dark surfaces are hue 235 and dark shadows are black, both of which the inferred values had wrong
Navigation/back rules, state restoration, motion table, haptics, loading rules, light/dark rules all recovered and recorded in design-system.md
Five screens: consumer home, category browse, listing detail, provider dashboard, wallet. Six new components incl. surface depths, ledger entry with VAT tie-line, week chart
97 tests pass, flutter analyze clean. The 47-test baseline carried unverified through two handoffs was re-run and confirmed
Tests caught four real bugs: two 360dp overflows, StatusChip pill blowout, and rentals offering a booking it has no flow for
notWorking: No way into the app - no splash, register, sign in, OTP or auth gate. Boots straight to Home. This is the ordering mistake noted in next steps
No Django backend; screens read core/demo_data.dart which is scaffolding to delete
Most screens still placeholders: booking request/status, ride tracking, rate & review, mode switcher, my categories, inbox, top up, become a provider, KYC, six settings screens
Never run on a handset or emulator - carried from two prior handoffs. The surface rework has never been seen rendered
navPillBg is the one remaining derived colour (inline literal, not a token)
VM stack untouched, still no schema
doNotRepeat: Claiming 'components came through complete' when meaning 'retrieved' - the set had gone 4 groups to 7. Say applied or retrieved, never blur them
Merging an old snapshot with a fresh pull to cover a truncated tail - produces a file where some values are current and some are days stale with nothing marking which
Grepping for backRules/motionSpecs/haptics to find the spec tables - the design rebuilt them as prose; the array names return zero hits in all four parts
Trying to split the canvas from the repo side - impossible by construction, reading the tail is what is blocked
A bare grep -o with a complex alternation over a 256 KB HTML file - catastrophic backtracking, 120s timeout. Use Python for structured extraction
sed -i '1i import ...' on a Dart file with a library; directive - puts the import above the doc comment and fails to parse
nextSteps: Close the account gap first (splash, register, sign in, OTP, biometric+passcode, consent, auth gate, location) - the design's own stated build order, and the auth gate is a dependency of booking request
Booking request + booking status: 11 states, carrying the payment-before-mark-complete correction
Pair the admin side in where a mobile flow needs it - first pair is KYC submission to admin verification queue to document review
Run it on a handset or emulator before building ten more screens on tokens nobody has looked at
Provider management surface: mode switcher, my categories, booking inbox, top up, become a provider, nine KYC screens
Six settings screens from part 4, then the stage-7 loop prompt
Retire stripe1/stripe2/info* from AppPalette if a later pull confirms they are gone rather than merely unused
blockers: Already-accepted bookings on category revoke - unchanged, still the code blocker for the admin Revoke action
Late-cancellation fee amount - percentage, flat, or first-occurrence waiver. Screens written so the number drops in
No-show consequence for providers - what happens, and after how many
Commission rate per category - rides shows 8%, trades and rentals unresolved
Dispute turnaround - screens promise contact but name no timeframe
Not yet designed at all: customer-provider messaging, provider listing management at scale, empty/offline states
Wallet naming vs compliance.md - design says 'wallet balance', the project's CLAUDE.md still says 'commission credit' and no screen follows it
Carried: reversal policy, negative balance, min top-up, hosting durability, EPS licensing, data residency, KYC retention, GPS DPIA
